name: Mecury Commercial Electronics
old_description: Our Advanced Concepts Group brings experts in early, so we know what’s possible and what isn’t, before missions even ask.
about:
Headquartered in Hudson, New Hampshire, Mercury Systems (operating under the Mecury Commercial Electronics name) designs and manufactures advanced electronics for aerospace and defense missions. The company operates a 50,000-square-foot production facility on its Phoenix campus, which opened recently to expand capacity and accelerate delivery timelines.

Its product portfolio includes direct RF multi-chip modules such as the RFS1140 built on AMD Versal adaptive SoCs, rad-tolerant 6U SpaceVPX processing boards like the SCFE6933, small-form-factor RF subsystems such as the DRF4580L with Intel Agilex 9 FPGAs, and broadband MMIC components for rugged defense environments. The company emphasizes chip-scale integration, open architectures, and model-based systems engineering to move from concept to production quickly.

Mercury serves the aerospace, defense, and space sectors, including missile defense, electronic warfare, and satellite programs. It has supported more than 75 spacecraft across all orbits and claims participation in every Mars mission over the past two decades. Customers include prime contractors and government agencies requiring ITAR-compliant, MIL-STD-qualified hardware for land, sea, air, and space domains.

The firm's Advanced Concepts Group engages early in technology development to shape commercial innovations into operational advantages, a strategy the company says ensures its solutions remain ahead of evolving threat environments.
